title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Code — newest changelog reserves the Claude Browser MCP server name, fixes Cowork VM-mode local-agent sessions failing to start, and adds login-expiry warnings + clearer agent/manual-mode badges
bullets.summary: The freshest Claude Code release (checked this third fire, newer than the mid-morning EndConversation/heartbeat entry) is a reliability-and-integration pass: it reserves the Claude Browser MCP server name (alongside Claude Preview) ahead of the Claude Desktop pane rename so user-configured servers can no longer register under either name, fixes Cowork VM-mode local-agent sessions that failed to start with 'Not logged in / Please run /login' on CLI 2.1.203+, fixes MCP transient errors during prompts/resources refresh that were wiping a server's slash commands, and fixes SessionStart hook events not streaming in headless sessions (which idle-reaped remote workers mid-hook). Plus login-expiry warnings, clearer agent-status/manual-mode badges, smoother background sessions, and a VS Code remote-control setting.
bullets.how: The Cowork VM-mode start fix is dead-on: The Construct runs its scans (this one included) as Cowork local-agent sessions and the 2.1.203+ '/login' failure is exactly the class of silent-death we've hit. Confirm our CLI is past the fix and audit for any MCP server we named Claude Browser / Claude Preview before the Desktop rename lands.

bullets.title: Omneky ships a public API + MCP server: one brand URL to a full, on-brand, multi-format ad set, agent-callable including by Claude
bullets.summary: Send Omneky a single URL and its agent reads the brand's positioning, colors and fonts, writes headline + CTA, and composes the product into finished ads in every major aspect ratio (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9), including UGC-style and short-form video, with automatic regeneration driven by performance/creative scoring to fight ad fatigue. The MCP server exposes this to any MCP client — a founder can tell their assistant 'make launch ads for our new product page' and get finished multi-format creative, no dashboard or prompt engineering. Paired video counterpart, same wedge: Revid.ai's video-production MCP (Jul 16) — script/prompt/audio-to-video with render_video/schedule_publish/publish_now.
bullets.how: Closest thing all day to Brand 9 Signs' and PRAGMA's core surface: zero-prompt, on-brand, multi-format ad creative from a URL, callable by our own Construct operator agent rather than a human in a design tool. Bench-and-possibly-adopt: run one real B9S brand URL through it and compare output + the ad-fatigue regeneration loop against our current Higgsfield + manual pipeline.

bullets.title: MCP specification 2026-07-28 goes final in 9 days — the largest breaking revision since launch (carried)
bullets.summary: The maintainers' RC stands: the core goes stateless (the initialize/initialized handshake and Mcp-Session-Id header are removed; any request can land on any instance), Streamable HTTP now requires Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name routing headers, list/read results carry ttlMs and cacheScope, authorization aligns to OAuth/OpenID Connect, and the missing-resource error moves from custom -32002 to standard -32602. SDK betas (Python v2 FastMCP->MCPServer; TypeScript v2 ESM-only, split into server/client packages; Go v1.7.0-pre.1; C# 2.0.0-preview.1) are out now.
bullets.how: Every MCP server The Construct runs is on the far side of a breaking change in 9 days. Two exposures remain live: any code matching the literal -32002, and any skill assuming session-scoped state the transport will no longer carry. The /doctor pass is the vehicle — produce the unused-server list and the Jul-28 migration inventory in one sitting, before the deadline, not on Jul 29.

bullets.title: arXiv orchestration cluster — task-adaptive routing + isolated per-agent context scoping, a governance frame for the fleet
bullets.summary: A live research vein this week on how enterprise agent fleets should route and isolate: 'AdaptOrch' argues that as base-model performance converges the differentiator shifts from model choice to task-adaptive orchestration (which agent, how much delegation), and 'Dynamic Attentional Context Scoping' gives each sub-agent a triggered, isolated focus session so context from one job doesn't bleed into another.
bullets.how: Vocabulary for what The Construct already does ad hoc: route the right skill/agent per task and keep each scan's context clean. Read against our CLAUDE.md governance and the /doctor output as a frame for the installed-skills registry — a framework to borrow, not a tool to install.

praxis_lesson: Two MCP servers in one week — Omneky (URL to full ad set) and Revid.ai (script to published video) — collapse the ad-creative and short-form-video pipelines into a single agent call, which is exactly Brand 9 Signs' and PRAGMA's surface. Same lesson the ad-platform MCP wave taught: the render is becoming a commodity API, so The Construct's durable edge is owning the orchestration and brand layer — the operator agent that decides which URL, which brand rules, which platform, and when to regenerate — not any single generator. Bench Omneky on a real B9S URL before adopting, and still run the one /doctor pass that yields both the unused-server list and the Jul-28 migration inventory before the deadline.
